column1: # Words whose e is not read by the default rules, respelled: in a reading, e is always the schwa
# (pepet, as in "besar") and é the e of "enak" (taling). Matching: the whole word, lower case; a
# word with a suffix (-nya -lah -kah -pun -ku -mu -kan -an -i) or a prefix (di- ke- se- ber- ter-
# per- pe- me-) uses the entry of its stem. See docs/frontend/pronunciation-rules.md.
